regime_context: The detector is in a narrow, low-certainty regime: energy leads with strong durability and breadth but has no tradable ETF proxy, and only 4 of 17 themes are trend-eligible — with all 4 eligible themes unscorable. The three scorable themes (China Tech & Internet, China Platform Megacaps) carry negative momentum and are NOT eligible, so the tradable universe is essentially thin. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market, but with no scorable eligible theme to express it through, actionable coverage is minimal. I am producing only one lean, on a scorable but trend-ineligible theme, and keeping conviction low.
emerging_watch: High-Dividend Blue Chips (hk_dividend) is the only other eligible theme with a strong durability_bar (0.70) and trend tag; it is currently unscorable, so I am NOT leaning on it. I am watching whether a Hong Kong dividend-themed ETF proxy becomes available/tradable in the next 20 trading days — if not, it stays unscorable and the watch is retired.

This is not a fade or short — the theme may well mean-revert higher — but under the system's own risk-control leg it is not a deployment vehicle.
